mutations.name: a timed-out ci-wait reads as a plain ci entry
mutations.find: if (ci?.success && ci.data.timedOut) return ciTimeoutEntry(result, ci.data.headSha, ci.data.timedOut);
mutations.replace: if (ci?.success && ci.data.timedOut && false) return ciTimeoutEntry(result, ci.data.headSha, ci.data.timedOut);
kills: a Shepherd run whose ci-wait times out while GitHub has not settled the PR waits again and reaches review once the PR settles, with no re-register, and the timeline shows the re-wait

mutations.name: the last attempt still says waiting again
mutations.find: const next = attempt < CI_WAIT_ATTEMPTS ? "waiting again" : "attempts spent, the run fails";
mutations.replace: const next = attempt <= CI_WAIT_ATTEMPTS ? "waiting again" : "attempts spent, the run fails";
kills: a Shepherd run whose ci-wait times out while GitHub has not settled the PR fails naming the attempt count, never reaching review, once every attempt times out
